en: A black-and-white vintage postcard image showing a broad, tree-lined street with a few pedestrians. On the right side of the image are large wooden buildings with awnings, likely shops or hotels. The left side is bordered by a wooden fence and more trees, with a view toward open countryside or riverbanks. The overall architectural style and the street scene indicate a European small-town setting from the early 20th century.
